d: Chief Justice of India Justice Surya Kant addresses members of the Supreme Court Bar Association on the occasion of Constitution Day, reflecting upon the endurance of the Indian Constitution and the institutional responsibilities of the legal profession. Justice Surya Kant emphasizes that the Constitution must ultimately be judged by what it means to ordinary citizens in the everyday exercise of power, rather than solely during extraordinary institutional crises.
